# `aitbc prometheus check`

Validate Prometheus config and rules with promtool.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc prometheus check [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | text | `/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml` | no | Prometheus config file |
| `--rules` | text | `/etc/prometheus/aitbc_rules.yml` | no | Prometheus rules file |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc prometheus check
```
